database.execution: isolated temporary cluster on loopback port 55439; disposable role and database; no Docker

finding: The current cursor serializes receivedAt to epoch milliseconds. When PostgreSQL stores submillisecond timestamps, rebuilding the next-page boundary from that cursor truncates the last row's timestamp. The tuple predicate then skips rows between the truncated boundary and the actual last-row timestamp. The SQL orders tied timestamps by id correctly when timestamp precision is preserved, but the API cursor loses precision.
classification: baseline defect observed; this is database evaluator evidence, not a coding-agent pilot run
